tips.title: Define Coordinate System for Rotary Machining
tips.body: Choose a CoordSys from the combo-box or select it from the graphic screen by clicking 'define'. The default MAC Number is 1.

tips.title: Set Tool Start Level
tips.body: Define the Z-level at which the tool starts in the Planar section of the CoordSys settings.

tips.title: Define clearance level for rapid tool travel
tips.body: Clearance level is the Z-level to which the tool rapidly travels between operations.

tips.title: Set part upper and lower levels for milling
tips.body: Part Upper level defines the height of the upper surface of the part to be milled, while Part Lower level defines the lower surface level.

tips.title: Define tool Z-level to avoid collisions
tips.body: Tool Z-level is the height that the tool moves to before rotating the 4/5 axes, avoiding collision with the workpiece.

tips.title: Configure translation data for machine coordinate system
tips.body: Shift and Rotation parameters define the distance and angle from Mac CoordSys to Position in the coordinate system.

tips.title: Select work plane for operations
tips.body: Choose the default work plane (XY, YZ, ZX) in the Plane section of CoordSys.

tips.title: Define roughing strategy for rotary machining
tips.body: Roughing strategy enables creation of the roughing tool path using Offset, Offset and Spiral methods.

tips.title: Define finishing strategy for rotary machining
tips.body: Finishing strategy enables creation of the finishing tool path.

tips.title: Set offset for machining surfaces
tips.body: Offset parameter allows defining the offset for the machining surfaces.

tips.title: Enable Side shift for rotary machining with roughing strategy
tips.body: Side shift allows using cutting edges instead of tool center, improving stability and close-to-diameter cutting.

tips.title: Set cone angle for conical workpieces
tips.body: Cone angle defines the angle between the cone line and rotary axis, improving machining normal to conical surfaces.

tips.title: Limit machining area using axial and radial limits
tips.body: Machining area check box allows setting limits for the machining area, useful when part needs to be clamped or only a special area requires machining.

tips.title: Define stock shape, size, and orientation
tips.body: Stock tab enables defining the shape, size, and orientation of the raw material to be machined around the machining surfaces.

tips.title: Set tolerance for tool deviation from surface
tips.body: Tolerance option allows setting the value for the tool to deviate from the surface.

tips.title: Define shrink or expand stock model
tips.body: Shrink/Expand options allow expanding or shrinking the stock model by a given value.

tips.title: Select tool from TOOLKIT table
tips.body: Click the Select button to display the TOOLKIT table and choose a tool for the operation.

tips.title: Define feed for rotary machining operation
tips.body: Feed value can be defined in units of F (Units per minute) or FZ (Units per tooth).

tips.title: Define spin for rotary machining operation
tips.body: Spin value can be defined in units of S (Revolutions per Minute) or V (Material cutting speed).

tips.title: Select gear producing the spinning speed
tips.body: Gear list enables selecting a Gear producing the spinning speed based on defined spin value.

tips.title: Define spin direction for rotary machining operation
tips.body: Choose between clockwise (CW) or counterclockwise (CCW) direction for the spinning speed.

tips.title: Define length offset number for tool
tips.body: Length offset number defines the number of the Length Offset Register of the current tool in the Offset table of the CNC-machine.

tips.title: Enable rapid feed replacement for CNC machines
tips.body: Check 'Rapid motion in Feed mode' to replace G0 with non-rapid movements using a specific feed rate.

tips.title: Define retract and safety distances
tips.body: Set 'Retract distance' for rapid descent, 'Safety distance' for approach movement, and 'Air move safety distance' for clearance area.

tips.title: Use boundary constraints for tool path optimization
tips.body: Enable 'Use 3D Boundary' to limit the tool path within defined boundaries, optimizing retracts and machining efficiency.

tips.title: Adjust surface quality parameters
tips.body: Set 'Cut tolerance' for tool path accuracy, 'Max. distance' for maximum point distance, and 'Step down' for cut level step.

tips.title: Define tool path sorting method
tips.body: Choose 'Zigzag' or 'One way' for cutting direction changes and define 'Direction for closed cuts' based on spindle rotation.

tips.title: Configure adaptive stepdown for roughing cuts
tips.body: Enable 'Intermediate slices' and choose between 'Constant Stepdown' or 'Number of slices' for step down calculation.

tips.title: Smooth tool path corners
tips.body: Select 'Corners %' to create fillets in sharp corners of inner contours and 'Final Contour %' for outer contour.

tips.title: Set rotary axis direction and base point
tips.body: Choose the rotary axis (X-, Y-, Z-axis) in 'Direction' and set the base point using 'Base point'.

tips.title: Define approach/retract and linking strategies
tips.body: Select 'Approach moves' type (Auto, Line, Helical) in 'Ramping' to control tool path approach and retraction.

tips.title: Define ramp angle for profile moves
tips.body: Set Ramp angle in Profile mode to define the angle at which the tool engages the stock.

tips.title: Set ramp length as percentage of tool diameter
tips.body: Use Ramp length (tool diameter %) to define the ramp length as a percentage of the tool diameter.

tips.title: Limit minimum ramp diameter
tips.body: Check Min. ramp diameter to limit the minimum diameter of the ramping movement.

tips.title: Use ramp for first entry movement
tips.body: Select Use ramp/Don’t use ramp to apply a ramp with the first entry movement.

tips.title: Use ramp for last exit movement
tips.body: Select Use ramp/Don’t use ramp to apply a ramp with the last exit movement.

tips.title: Define approach from rapid distance
tips.body: Select Approach from rapid distance to apply cutting position once the tool reaches rapid distance.

tips.title: Define approach from feed distance
tips.body: Select Approach from feed distance to apply plunge or cutting feed rate on the feed distance.

tips.title: Define retract to rapid distance
tips.body: Select Retract to rapid distance to apply straight line connection with retracting tool to the specified rapid distance.

tips.title: Define retract to feed distance
tips.body: Select Retract to feed distance to apply straight line connection with retracting tool to the specified feed distance.

tips.title: Define link type for area connections
tips.body: Select Direct, Blend spline, or Step to define connection moves between tool paths in the same level.

tips.title: Define link type for links between slices
tips.body: Select Direct, Blend spline, Step, Retract to feed distance, or Retract to rapid distance to define connection moves between cutting layers.

tips.title: Define link type for links between regions
tips.body: Select Direct, Blend spline, Retract to feed distance, or Retract to rapid distance to define connection moves between different machining regions.

tips.title: Define approach/retreat type
tips.body: Select Tangential arc, Tangential line, or Orthogonal line to define the approach/retreat movement.

tips.title: Define approach/retreat dimensions
tips.body: Set Width/Length to define the bounding rectangle surrounding the arc or line.

tips.title: Define approach/retreat arc sweep/diameter
tips.body: Set Arc sweep/Arc diameter to specify the diameter of the approach/retreat arc using the percentage of the Arc diameter to the Tool diameter.

tips.title: Define approach/retreat feed rate
tips.body: Set Feed rate to define the feed rate for the approach/retreat movement.

tips.title: Use default lead-in/lead-out settings for finishing
tips.body: Enable Default Lead-In/Out page when Strategy is selected as Finishing to define parameters for approach/retreat movements.

tips.title: Select second rotation angle
tips.body: InventorCAM chooses an angle pair where the second rotation angle is closer to the Rotation angle value parameter.

tips.title: Deactivate Minimum angle change for single axis machines
tips.body: If a machine can only use one of the angle pairs due to mechanical limitations, deactivate the Minimum angle change option.

tips.title: Use machine limits to restrict tool path movements
tips.body: Enable the Machine limits option to use machine-defined limits for translation and/or rotation axis movements.

tips.title: Ignore machine limits with No limits option
tips.body: Select the No limits option to ignore all machine-defined limits for tool path movements.

tips.title: Handle pole areas in 5-axis machining
tips.body: Use multiple methods to handle pole areas, such as freezing angle around pole or using rotation angle around pole.

tips.title: Set angle limits for output tool paths
tips.body: Define angle limits in the Move list writer options to ensure compatibility with specific CNC-Machine controllers.

tips.title: Control angular tool movements with Angle change parameter
tips.body: Set the maximal angle variation between two successive tool positions to control retract movements.

tips.title: Set retract distance for angle change
tips.body: Define the distance of the retract movement when the angle change exceeds the Angle change value.

tips.title: Use Retract&Rewind option for rotational axis limits
tips.body: Enable the Retract&Rewind option to retract to a safe area and perform a reverse rotation when reaching maximum limit.

tips.title: Set interpolation angle step for distance and angles
tips.body: Use the Interpolation angle step parameter to interpolate linear and angular movements.

tips.title: Limit rotation angle with Max. angle step for rotation axis
tips.body: Set the maximum rotation angle to limit the distance between two tool path points due to machine kinematics.

variables.Number of Flutes: number of flutes on the tool

variables.V: Material cutting speed in Meters per Minute
